description: Evidence-location questions for the launch profile's activation battery (Appendix A: 100 evidence-location questions balanced over early/middle/late positions in 16k/32k/64k contexts, at least 90% correct cited source ids at each tested length). This fixture set is illustrative and far short of the required population of 100. Context length is approximated by shard_size (the number of synthetic filler papers alongside the one gold paper, up to the launch profile's 20-paper shard cap); position_bucket names the gold paper's index among them. Grading checks that the run retrieved the gold paper through deep_read before an accepted submit, as a proxy for citing the correct evidence source id pending #117's real evidence-id submission contract.
